We need to evaluate model on test set and cross-validation. Use evaluate_xgboost_model tool for test set evaluation (includes feature importance). Then perform_cross_validation for CV. Then combine results into JSON and write file.

First, evaluate_xgboost_model with model_path and test_data_path from metadata. Need test_path. Extract from metadata JSON. We have test_path: "/Users/.../oxide_ml_dataset/test.csv". Use that.

Call evaluate_xgboost_model with detailed_analysis True.
